title: Who needs Making Tax Digital for Income Tax and when
summary: You need to use Making Tax Digital for Income Tax if you are a sole trader or landlord registered for Self Assessment, you get income from self-employment or property (or both), and your qualifying income is more than the relevant threshold. Start dates depend on qualifying income in a prior tax year: more than £50,000 for 2024-25 means from 6 April 2026; more than £30,000 for 2025-26 means from 6 April 2027; more than £20,000 for 2026-27 means from 6 April 2028. Partnerships will be brought in later. Always confirm on GOV.UK.

title: MTD Income Tax £50,000 threshold starts 6 April 2026
summary: If your qualifying income was more than £50,000 for the 2024-25 tax year (2024 to 2025), you need to use Making Tax Digital for Income Tax from 6 April 2026. Qualifying income is total self-employment and property income before expenses (turnover/gross), not profit. Do not confuse this £50,000 / April 2026 band with the later £30,000 / April 2027 band.

title: MTD Income Tax £30,000 threshold starts 6 April 2027
summary: If your qualifying income is more than £30,000 for the 2025-26 tax year (2025 to 2026), you need to use Making Tax Digital for Income Tax from 6 April 2027. This is not April 2026. April 2026 applies only to the higher £50,000 qualifying-income band (based on 2024-25). Qualifying income is turnover/gross self-employment and property income before expenses, not profit after expenses.

title: MTD Income Tax £20,000 threshold starts 6 April 2028
summary: If your qualifying income is more than £20,000 for the 2026-27 tax year (2026 to 2027), you need to use Making Tax Digital for Income Tax from 6 April 2028. Qualifying income is total self-employment and property income before expenses (turnover/gross), not profit.

title: What qualifying income means for MTD
summary: Qualifying income for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax is total income from self-employment and property before expenses (also described as turnover/gross income), based on the relevant Self Assessment return. Employment (PAYE), dividends, State Pension and private pensions do not count towards qualifying income. Do not confuse turnover with profit.

title: MTD digital records and quarterly updates
summary: Using Making Tax Digital for Income Tax means using compatible software to create, store and correct digital records of business income and expenses, and to send quarterly updates to HMRC. Exact software requirements and update dates should be confirmed on GOV.UK.
